title: Implement media upload area on new batch page
description: Add a media library upload section to the new batch creation page. Allows uploading curated stock images with the naming convention {slot}-{industry}-{descriptor}.{ext} before running generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Media upload area is visible on the new batch page (after batch name/industry are set)
Drag-and-drop or click-to-upload UI is present
Filename convention is explained with examples in the UI
Uploaded files show in a list with filename, slot, and industry parsed from the name
Files with invalid names show an error inline
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.description: Add media upload section to new batch page
steps.details: Below the tab section, add a collapsible 'Media Library (Optional)' section. Expand to show the upload area with instructions: 'Name files as: {slot}-{industry}-{descriptor}.jpg (e.g., hero-roofing-tiles.jpg)'.

Create a `MediaUploadArea` client component. Use a hidden `<input type='file' accept='image/*' multiple>` triggered by clicking or dragging onto a styled dropzone div. On drop/select, validate filenames and show preview list.

For each file: show filename, inferred slot and industry (parsed from name), status (valid/invalid/uploading/uploaded). Invalid filenames show a red error. After batch is created, upload files to the batch's media endpoint.
Take Playwright screenshot. Drag a file onto the dropzone and verify it appears in the list with correct slot/industry parsed.
